name: null_semantics
comment: ADR-0020: Eq(null) renders IS NULL and Ne(null) IS NOT NULL — never '= NULL', which silently matches nothing. Explicit IsNull/IsNotNull render identically.

sqlite.sql: select id, name, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at from users where (display_name is null and email is not null and updated_at is null and name is not null)
